value.rationale: A sharp universal design corridor for independently switching gate search is a meaningful structural threshold, showing a guaranteed benefit region and an impossible-benefit region for weak resets, independent of kinetic rates. It rigorously distinguishes a commonly conflated reset protocol, with both bounds asymptotically attainable and a strictly decreasing threshold as the closed/open ratio rises.
